decision.live_dispatch_reason: The new folder had no exact-hash review lock, launch-precheck attempt, freshness record, or capture at review time. Those are separate explicit launch gates.

checks.evidence: All 43 plan source hashes match current tree bytes; all 34 backend pins match blobs at source commit 1eff0a24c5177c0df7c57284dbc724385637214d. The selector commit 75f52cb is an ancestor of that source commit, which is contained in origin/main. The harness rejects backend differences and recomputes the plan before launch and dispatch.

Recomputed exact author wire SHA-256 0317c2b75115c309232c02e6eddcedd230461fc63f5d18da7312502868092a0a, 2,357-byte schema SHA-256 495db717d6b3fd6cc5272cdb289c7d77d9ca2e275b7c1d3f0cb856c1a18b6934, and matching system/user prompt hashes. All match the accepted v12 author plan; request bytes also match the previous trial.

Prior v12 capture and RESULTS.md retain their pinned hashes. The prior capture still reports four returned questions, returned ordinals 0–3, and original slot 4 unfilled. The new harness enforces those facts and uses separate paths in its new folder for capture, review lock, launch attempt, and freshness record.

One mixed job has five original 3:2 slots and six durable Converse reservations at most. Each SDK client has one attempt, a three-second connect timeout, and at most a 200-second read timeout. The 240-second SIGALRM begins before execute credential export and STS. A second author pass, fallback, top-up, repeat job, bank/queue write, or deploy is outside this guarded path; capture creation is exclusive and precedes credentials.

Ten tests passed directly and under --preflight. The socket-blocked preflight also passed and reported provider_calls=0. The fake full route returns five original slots with policies 8/8/8/10/10 and selects the intended select_archive/singular_first task for slot 4 when another English family is authored.

The pinned Boto3, Botocore, and awscrt versions (1.43.91/1.43.91/0.36.0), AWS CLI 2.33.15, default-profile file check, and CLI executable check all passed without sockets. Launch precheck is one-shot and requires at least 360 seconds of exported credential life, with 330 seconds still available at execute. Execute exports a new snapshot requiring at least 300 seconds and reserves one STS request. The AWS CLI export may perform a Signin refresh whose exact remote call count is not observed by the harness; this is disclosed in the frozen record and confined to one bounded export process.

limitations.detail: The new selector preference applies when another English family is authored and first-batch history is empty; the live model may produce a different author payload. A fake five-slot return does not establish live 5/5 qualification.
CLI Signin refresh count during credential export is not instrumented; the record states unobserved; bounded 0-1. No such export or AWS request was performed in this audit.
